text.index.html: Page shell of the docs site, titled Lantern documentation, with its description and social tags, which loads the app
text.package.json: Dependencies and scripts of the docs site, kept apart from the Electron app
text.pnpm-workspace.yaml: Makes the docs site its own pnpm root so it never joins the app's lockfile
text.tsconfig.json: Type-check settings for the docs site and its build plugins
text.vite.config.ts: Sets the docs site base path and site URL from the environment and registers its build plugins
